<!-- Tool and model used (for example Claude Code with Sonnet, ChatGPT Free), and the tier the task is assigned to. If they differ, say why. -->

<!-- What changed and why. -->

<!-- Choices made autonomously, and anything waiting on owner review. -->

<!-- Untested platforms or providers, sources that could not be read, known gaps. -->

<!-- Official documentation, standards and other sources used, with dates checked. Required by CLEAN_ROOM.md. -->
